metadata.title: चाईबासा में जोबा-गीता की जंग | Battle between Joba Majhi and Geeta Koda for Chaibasa
metadata.description: The election battle in Chaibasa, Jharkhand, has intensified with two tribal women, Joba Manjhi from the Congress-JMM alliance and Geeta Koda from the BJP, competing for the seat. Geeta Koda, wife of former CM Madhu Koda, has switched allegiance from Congress to BJP. Rahul Gandhi today rallied support for Joba Manjhi, with Kalpana Soren, wife of jailed leader Hemant Soren, also addressing the gathering. IThe rally has undoubtedly stirred the political landscape of Chaibasa, with voters considering the rhetoric and promises put forth by both sides.
